problem.title: The real bottleneck isn't client demand. It's parallel context switching.

items.title: The 15-minute search panic
items.quote: “The true cost isn't software subscriptions — it's the 15 minutes of frantic searching before a client call: 'Wait, where did I log that conversation?'”
items.body: When you lead 6+ engagements across different channels, vital commitments end up scattered between notepad scraps, chat messages, and mental notes.

items.title: Decisions vanish in transit
items.quote: “Tools haven't met the client. They don't know what was promised in that room three months ago.”
items.body: Task trackers store simple checkboxes. They don't preserve the strategic rationale of why a roadmap pivoted or what tradeoffs were accepted.

items.title: 30–60 min evening typing debt
items.quote: “Admin work turns into detective work. If we don't bill clients, we make no income at all.”
items.body: Reconstructing follow-ups, typing summaries, and filing tickets across client boards drains high-value energy that should go toward advisory work.

items.title: Human cognitive overload
items.quote: “Every process lived only in my head. That scared me more than lost revenue did.”
items.body: You carry both high-stakes client deliverables and operational commitments in your own working memory. When your brain is the database, your practice hits a hard ceiling.

problem.closing: This isn't a discipline issue. It is the inevitable breakdown of running high parallelism without a unified operational memory.

cards.title: Directional continuity

cards.title: Zero cognitive friction
cards.body: Conventional task managers force arbitrary dates on non-urgent thoughts, creating cognitive exhaustion from constantly postponing them. Open Questions live separate from your calendar — keeping your daily agenda clean while ensuring nothing slips.

commitments.title: Clear the mental noise: all recurring obligations in one transparent register.
commitments.subtitle: A consulting practice is powered by an individual. Scattering recurring SaaS tools, servers, client subscriptions, and personal commitments across accounts creates constant background anxiety.
commitments.body: Logitaka unifies recurring obligations into a single lifecycle register: who you pay, from which account, exact amounts, and renewal dates. Reminders surface in your internal calendar a month ahead and in Pulse a week ahead — so you know precisely what to renew, pause, or cancel.

valueStack.subtitle: To piece together what Logitaka delivers in a single interface, you would need to juggle 3–4 disconnected SaaS products — each with its own login and isolated memory.
valueStack.disclaimer: Prices verified across public vendor pricing pages (Sept 2026). Logitaka replaces disjointed subscriptions with unified context.

privacy.title: Concrete privacy mechanisms, not marketing slogans.
privacy.subtitle: Senior advisors handle sensitive client roadmaps and NDAs. We don't ask for blind trust — we build upon verifiable architectural boundaries.

pillars.title: EU Data Residency
pillars.body: Production infrastructure and user data are hosted on dedicated servers strictly located within the European Union (Hetzner Cloud, Germany/Finland).

pillars.title: Ephemeral Intake & Physical Purge
pillars.body: Voice input is processed in volatile memory, and uploaded files are physically erased immediately after deliverables are finalized. No client audio or files sit indefinitely in cloud buckets.

pillars.title: Workspace Segregation & Hardened Auth
pillars.body: Client streams are strictly segregated at the filesystem runtime level. User authentication uses cryptographic scrypt key derivation and constant-time comparisons, with HTTPS/TLS across all endpoints.

pillars.title: Total Ownership & Cascade Erasure
pillars.body: Your practice memory belongs entirely to you. Export your entire history, decisions, and profile in open Markdown at any time, or execute a complete cascade account purge.

items.question: How does the free Pro trial work?
items.answer: Create a new Logitaka account before January 1, 2027 at midnight Baku time (UTC+4). After you verify your email, you get Pro access and $2 in trial credit. The trial ends after 14 days or when the credit runs out, whichever comes first. You can start without a payment card and choose a paid plan if you want to continue.

items.question: How is my client data protected and stored?
items.answer: All production infrastructure and data stores reside strictly within the European Union (Hetzner Cloud, Germany/Finland) communicating via HTTPS/TLS. Voice transcription is handled in volatile memory without caching persistent audio, and uploaded documents are physically erased from disk immediately upon artifact generation. Client streams are strictly segregated at the runtime directory level, and you retain the right to export your entire practice in open Markdown or trigger a complete cascade account deletion at any time.

items.question: Why doesn't Logitaka join client calls as an AI bot?
items.answer: Clients increasingly ban bot notetakers due to GDPR risks, sensitive IP, and recent high-profile cloud recording leaks. Inviting a bot into executive meetings creates unnecessary tension. With Logitaka, you either conduct a 60-second debrief in Talk Live immediately after the sync or drop your meeting recording into Inbox. Context is extracted, structured into client streams, and the raw audio is permanently deleted.

items.question: Why don't all tasks sync to my Apple or Google Calendar?
items.answer: This is a deliberate design principle. An active consultant handles 8–10 tasks a day across multiple clients. Syncing them to an external calendar turns your schedule into an unusable wall of all-day banners. Logitaka only syncs timed events (meetings and deadlines with specific hours) to your external calendar. Your complete task list lives in your Logitaka workspace and arrives every morning in your no-scroll Telegram brief.

items.question: What is the difference between Tasks and Decision Memory?
items.answer: Tasks define what needs to be executed today. Decision Memory records directional choices — why a specific path was chosen and what changes moving forward. Standard project tools forget why an agreement was made the moment a ticket is marked complete. Logitaka maintains long-term decision continuity so you always know what was promised months ago.

items.question: What are Open Questions and why don't they have dates?
items.answer: Traditional task managers require an arbitrary due date for every logged item, causing cognitive fatigue as you repeatedly postpone non-urgent tasks day after day. In Logitaka, Open Questions capture thoughts, strategic questions, and pending items that have no immediate deadline. They stay safely organized by project without polluting your daily calendar.

items.question: How does team delegation work without user seats?
items.answer: Logitaka treats collaborators as a Registry of Responsibility. You assign tasks and milestones to team members or external contractors within your system. They subscribe to a secure calendar feed and receive their timed commitments directly in their phone calendar — without ever logging into your Logitaka workspace or accessing confidential client context.

items.question: How are time tracking and invoicing handled?
items.answer: Because every consulting practice evaluates work differently (fixed fee, retainers, hourly milestones), Logitaka avoids rigid, one-size-fits-all billing modules. Instead, time tracking and billing criteria are created as tailored User Skills via Skill Builder, executing exactly according to your defined methodology.
